    A friend who knows the city.

    We slow down, follow curiosity, and discover places together, one story at a time. The best moments are rarely planned.

    A True Amsterdammer

    The Person

    I have always been drawn to stories, people and places that move you in some way.

    Amsterdam became that place for me. I’ve called this city home for more than twenty years now, and over time it became an integral part of who I am.

    This city gave me freedom. It connected me to the world and shaped me into the person I am today. Curious, creative and fascinated by culture, art, architecture, nature, and the rhythm of life.

    Helping you find your own way

    The Guide

    For me, discovering places should feel personal, relaxed and natural. More like spending time with a local friend.

    I always listen first. Every person experiences a place differently, which is why I take the time to understand who you are and what inspires you.

    I carefully shape each day around you, creating experiences that feel meaningful. More than anything, I’m simply somebody who walks beside you during your trip.

    Co-Founder Projects

    AroundFriends

    In addition to my work as a travel advisor and local guide in Amsterdam and the Netherlands, I am the co-founder and Guide Community Director of AroundFriends.

    AroundFriends is a guide-matching platform that connects travelers with carefully selected local guides. Travelers complete a short questionnaire and are then matched with guides who fit their travel style and interests. They can explore detailed guide profiles, watch personal introduction videos, and connect directly with guides before booking, creating a more personal and transparent way to plan meaningful travel experiences.

    The platform was born from a shared belief that travel becomes more meaningful when it is built on genuine human connection and local insight.

    “The brainchild of recommended guide Dennis Gerrits.”

    From my notebook

    Notes from the City · D.G.

    chapter 1

    Asparagus Season

    ✦

    Every spring, my best friend and I return to the same restaurant in Amsterdam for one very special dish: Dutch white asparagus.

    12

    I grew up in the south of the Netherlands, where white asparagus is a true seasonal delicacy. Every spring we celebrate the season with a traditional Dutch meal, a good glass of wine, and a table by the canal. It's one of those simple traditions I look forward to every year, because asparagus tastes best when nature says it's time.

    – D.
